snippet.title: Animal Shelter 2 - Release Trailer | STEAM
snippet.description:
Animal Shelter 2 is now available on Steam! 😻 Your furry friends are waiting - start your new adventure in CO-OP Mode 🤗 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658510/Animal_Shelter_2/

Play with them, pet them, even dress them up! 🐶 bGet to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in CO-OP Dode with up to 6 players! ☺️
